table.name: TLGNS_SAP_VN_PF_COMM_CARRIER
table.description: The commercial carrier partner functions of a given VN-PORG to another VN-PORG. The 'Purchasing Organisation' information is highly redundant, and must be identical in a) owner b) executing carrier c) this table.

column.name: SAP_VENDOR_PORG_ID
column.description: Part of PK, FK tlgns_sap_vendor_porg. The owning VN+purchasing organisation of the partner function (SAP: defined by E1LFA1M_LIFNR from the VN general data which ownes the partner function).

column.name: COMM_SAP_VENDOR_PORG_ID
column.description: Part of PK, FK tlgns_sap_vendor_porg. The referred subcontractor, including its Purchasing Organisation Data. (SAP: defined by E1WYT3M_LIFN2)

column.name: PURCHASINGORG_CD
column.description: Part of PK, FK tlgnr_purchasingorg_bs. The Purchasing Organisation for which this partner function is defined.
